name: D & S Hedging

metaDesc: D & S Hedging, Mildura VIC: mechanical hedging, topping and skirting for citrus, nut, stone fruit, avocado and olive growers, 5 to 500 hectares. Call 0429 333 573.

hero.title: Mechanical hedging for Sunraysia orchards.

servicesSub: Call 0429 333 573 to book or talk about your block.

services.title: Hedging
services.long: Mechanical hedging for orchards and plantations, keeping rows tidy and trees in shape.

services.title: Topping & skirting
services.long: Topping to manage tree height and skirting to lift the lower canopy.

services.title: Wind breaks
services.long: Creating wind breaks to protect your trees and crop.

services.title: Fire trails & roads
services.long: Fire trail work and road maintenance to keep access around your property clear.

whyText: We work for small growers and large corporations, with current OH&S procedures and full public liability insurance.
gallerySub: Citrus, nuts, stone fruit, avocados and olives.
faq: What crops do you work on?
Citrus, nuts, stone fruit, avocados and olives.
How big a property do you take on?
From 5 to 500 hectares, for small growers and large corporations.
Yes, we hold full public liability insurance and follow current OH&S procedures.
Call 0429 333 573, ring the office on (03) 5025 7597, or send the form on the contact page.
aboutParas: D & S Hedging is a Mildura contractor doing mechanical hedging and pruning for orchards and plantations.
We do hedging, topping, skirting, wind breaks, fire trails and road maintenance for citrus, nut, stone fruit, avocado and olive growers, on properties from 5 to 500 hectares.
contactSub: Tell us about your block and we'll be in touch. Or call 0429 333 573.
